name: Zechariah
bio: Zechariah, grandson of Iddo (called here simply "son of Iddo"), together with Haggai the prophet, prophesied to the Jews of Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, encouraging Zerubbabel and Jeshua to resume building the temple after years of delay; the two prophets helped them as the work went forward (Ezra 5:1-2). His own visions and messages are recorded in full in the book that bears his name. Through their prophesying, the elders of the Jews prospered in the work and finished the temple in the sixth year of Darius, dedicating it with joy (Ezra 6:14-16).
